run_benchmark_rgd_planner: run the RGD planner benchmark on PushWorld puzzles with the Novelty+RGD heuristic
run_benchmark_rgd_planner_custom: run the RGD planner benchmark with a custom time limit and memory limit
run_benchmark_rgd_planner_rgd: run the RGD planner benchmark using the RGD heuristic instead of Novelty+RGD
run_benchmark_rgd_planner_single: run the RGD planner benchmark on a single PushWorld puzzle file
run_benchmark_rgd_planner_results: run the RGD planner benchmark and save YAML results to a specified directory
